text: {"score":4,"justification":"Numbers match the card, and the summary is cautious and well grounded. Weaknesses are a few claim-level narrative details that the card does not support and a next-step list that omits the most targeted action.","problems":["Narrative says URI on C0091972/C0091987 (J06.9 supports this) and 'rash' on C0092070, C0092122, C0092165, but those claims carry dx R21, which is rash; this is fine, though the 'simple acute problems' framing is the writer's inference.","The claim that 'the 0-, 1- and 2-condition bands run several times the all-provider share' is accurate, but the 3-condition band is not elevated, and the headline's 'every complexity band' is overstated (3-, 4- and 5+-condition bands are below the all-provider share).","The structured next_steps ask for a larger sample of 99214/99215 records and a re-screen, but do not name the specific low-complexity or repeat-patient claims that the rationale says to request first; the targeted action is only in the prose.","The cited example claims (C0091944, C0091952) are generic low-complexity examples and do not tie to the repeat-patient or C0092113 points that the rationale makes.","The 'flag cloned or inflated notes' point on C0092113 is speculative from a single chart with no time recorded, though it is hedged.","The 99214 documentation (16 charts, 0 below billed) is not mentioned, and the missing-data context is thin."]}
